import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, t;
    static Room[][] floorplan;

    static class Room {
        int i, j;
        boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int scientists, capsules;

        Room() {
            scientists = 0;
            capsules = 0;
            Arrays.fill(infected, false);
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        }

        int getNodeId(int timestamp) {
            return 2 + i + n * j + (n * n) * timestamp;
        }

        void setReactor() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void setInfected(int timestamp) {
            if (timestamp <= t && accessible[timestamp]) {
                accessible[timestamp] = false;
                infected[timestamp] = true;
            }
        }

        void spreadInfection(int timestamp) {
            if (infected[timestamp]) {
                setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i < n - 1) floorplan[i + 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j < n - 1) floorplan[i][j + 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static class EdmondsKarp {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev;
            double cap;
            Edge(int to, int rev, double cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        List<List<Edge>> g;

        EdmondsKarp(int n) {
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        void addEdge(int v, int to, double cap) {
            Edge a = new Edge(to, g.get(to).size(), cap);
            Edge b = new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), 0.0);
            g.get(v).add(a);
            g.get(to).add(b);
        }

        double augment(int s, int t) {
            double[] cap = new double[g.size()];
            int[] parent = new int[g.size()];
            int[] parentEdge = new int[g.size()];
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            Arrays.fill(parentEdge, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();

            cap[s] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
            q.add(s);

            while (!q.isEmpty() && cap[t] == 0.0) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int i = 0; i < g.get(v).size(); i++) {
                    Edge e = g.get(v).get(i);
                    if (e.cap > 1e-12 && cap[e.to] == 0.0) {
                        cap[e.to] = Math.min(cap[v], e.cap);
                        parent[e.to] = v;
                        parentEdge[e.to] = i;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (cap[t] == 0.0) return 0.0;

            for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                int pv = parent[v];
                int pe = parentEdge[v];
                Edge e = g.get(pv).get(pe);
                e.cap -= cap[t];
                g.get(v).get(e.rev).cap += cap[t];
            }

            return cap[t];
        }

        double maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            double total = 0.0;
            while (true) {
                double f = augment(s, t);
                if (f <= 1e-12) break;
                total += f;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();

        floorplan = new Room[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
            }
        }

        // read first grid (scientists, Y, Z)
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setReactor();
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].setInfected(0);
                } else {
                    floorplan[i][j].scientists = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // read second grid (capsules)
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    floorplan[i][j].capsules = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        // spread infection over time
        for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (c < t) {
                        floorplan[i][j].spreadInfection(c);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // build flow network
        int nodeCount = n * n * (t + 1) + 2;
        EdmondsKarp mf = new EdmondsKarp(nodeCount);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                if (room.scientists > 0) {
                    mf.addEdge(0, room.getNodeId(0), room.scientists);
                }
                if (room.capsules > 0) {
                    mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(t), 1, room.capsules);
                }
                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) {
                        mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), room.getNodeId(t), 1000);
                    }
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        if (i > 0 && floorplan[i - 1][j].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i - 1][j].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (i < n - 1 && floorplan[i + 1][j].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i + 1][j].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j > 0 && floorplan[i][j - 1].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i][j - 1].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j < n - 1 && floorplan[i][j + 1].accessible[c]) {
                            mf.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), floorplan[i][j + 1].getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int) mf.maxFlow(0, 1));
        sc.close();
    }
}
